caption: The drawing depicts a decorative spoon placed vertically against a plain, light beige background. The handle of the spoon is ornate and elongated, featuring intricate gold and gray details, including scroll-like and shell-shaped designs near the top. The bowl of the spoon is round with a gold border and showcases an image of a gold coin or medallion at its center. The coin design displays an eagle with outspread wings clutching arrows, and visible text around the edge reads “UNITED STATES OF AMERICA” and “FIFTY DOL.” with the year “1852” at the bottom. The central motif of the spoon is predominantly gold and brown, while the surrounding frame and handle combine shades of gold and gray. The composition isolates the decorated spoon against a minimal background with no other objects present.
title: Souvenir Spoon
